jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer (Claude Code, Cursor)
jobs.description: About Nordavo Nordavo connects Dutch tech companies with engineers in Bangalore. Our clients range from SaaS companies building their own product to agencies building AI systems for their customers. You work from our office in Indiranagar, on our payroll, as a full member of the clients team. We handle HR and everything around it. More about us: https://nordavo.nl The role Most Dutch tech teams dont write their code by hand anymore. They build with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and they need engineers who can make those agents do real work. Not demos. Systems that keep running when nobody is watching. Depending on the client, that means product features, internal tools or automations behind the scenes. You wont get a ticket with every step written out. You get a problem, some context and a lead who expects you to figure out the rest and come back with a plan. What youll do Build agents, workflows, features and internal tools with Claude Code, Cursor and other agent harnesses Design the setup around each agent: tools, context, permissions, memory and checks Work on the layer underneath: servers, databases, APIs, integrations, RAG and vector databases Set up evals and logging, and find out why an agent went wrong Review what the agent wrote before it goes live. You own the result, not the AI Join the team’s stand-ups and keep your lead updated without being asked Skills we look for You build with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or a similar agent every day, and you can show what you built with it You know how to extend your harness: MCP servers, subagents, hooks, skills, rules and custom commands. You’ve set these up yourself, not just read about them You fix agent problems with context, tools and feedback loops, not only with a better prompt You understand what the agent produces. You can read the code, spot when it’s wrong and explain every line if someone asks Solid basics: Git, pull requests, APIs, databases and debugging You think about security. You know where secrets go, what permissions an agent should not have and what happens if it fails halfway You keep an eye on cost and speed. A workflow that burns tokens for no reason is a bad workflow 2 to 5 years of experience as a developer or engineer How you work You ask questions until a task is clear, and you say so when you disagree You flag problems early and give honest estimates You write short, clear updates without being asked You take ownership of what you build, also when it breaks Nice to have n8n, Supabase, Next.js or similar Experience working with European or US teams A public repo, blog or video about how you work with agents Nordavo Groningen Bangalore • Indiranagar office • https://nordavo.nl 2-5 Yrs Nextjs, Artificial Intelligence, GIT, DBMS, Python, MCP, Vector, Coding

jobs.title: Sr. Solutions Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Description Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart. The Opportunity Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on. We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents. In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person. You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right. Your Role Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments. Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it. Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. jobs.description: We are looking for a AI Engineer to build our next-generation Agentic AI platform from 01. This is a hands-on, delivery-driven role for a senior engineer who has shipped AI-powered products into real enterprise environments, understands the trade-offs of production AI systems, and takes full ownership of outcomes not just models or demos. You will work alongside our VP of Engineering, VP of AI and product leadership to define and build the core AI systems of the platform. You will spend most of your time designing, coding, and shipping production-grade AI capabilities used by external B2B customers. Success is measured by reliability, controllability, cost-efficiency, and customer impact not novelty. Here is how, through this exciting role, YOU will contribute to BMC's and your own success: Design, build, and evolve agentic AI systems that reason, plan, execute, and adapt in production environments. Take AI-driven features from concept to production in a true 01 product environment. Write and review high-quality production code (Python-first) across AI pipelines, inference services, orchestration layers, and supporting systems. Implement prompt engineering, tool use, memory, evaluation, and guardrails as first-class engineering concerns, not experiments. Design agent frameworks that balance autonomy with determinism, observability, and safety. Make pragmatic architectural trade-offs across latency, cost, accuracy, scalability, and maintainability. Integrate and operate LLMs (commercial and/or open-source) including model selection, fine-tuning strategies, embeddings, retrieval (RAG), and inference optimization. Address real-world issues: hallucinations, drift, prompt regressions, failure modes, and customer trust. Deploy and operate AI services across cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including secure enterprise integrations and customer-specific deployments. Design scalable inference and orchestration architectures using containers, APIs, and distributed systems. Ensure the platform is shippable, debuggable, and supportable not fragile or research-grade. Act with founder-level ownership: identify gaps, propose solutions, and move forward without waiting for perfect requirements. To ensure youre set up for success, you will bring the following skillset experience: 10+ years of professional software development experience, with significant time shipping B2B products used by external customers. Strong software engineering foundation with expert-level Python and experience designing production systems. Proven experience building, deploying, and operating AI-powered products in production not just prototypes or research. Hands-on experience with LLMs and GenAI systems in real applications (e.g., agents, copilots, automation, decision systems). Deep understanding of at least several of the following: Agent frameworks and orchestration Prompt engineering and tool-use patterns RAG architectures and vector search Model evaluation, feedback loops, and monitoring Safety, guardrails, and enterprise controls Hands-on experience with multiple of the following in real systems: LangGraph and/or LangChain LlamaIndex Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, Milvus) Prompt engineering as a managed, versioned, testable artifact Experience deploying and operating LLMs using: -AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent managed platforms. Direct API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic) Experience designing multi-agent systems or complex agent workflows. Experience commercializing AI features under enterprise constraints (security, compliance, uptime). Comfort operating in ambiguity and making decisions with incomplete information. Whilst these are nice to have, our team can help you develop in the following skills: Contributions to open-source GenAI tooling or internal frameworks used at scale Experience with Supervised fine-tuning, Parameter-efficient tuning methods (LoRA, QLoRA), reinforcement learning (RLHF) and preference optimization (PPO, DPO, GRPO). Experience deploying LLMs at scale (Kubernetes, model serving, GPU optimization). 2-5 Yrs Intelligence, Architecture, Microsoft, Vertex, Software development, Machine learning, Enterprise, AWS

jobs.title: Sr. Full Stack AI Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary About the Role: GSK s Enterprise AI team builds AI solutions that prove value fast and scale to production. The Forward Deployed Engineer is the engineer GSK sends in to find out whether an AI idea will work - embedded with business unit teams, proving ideas through PoCs, PoVs, and MVPs at a days-to-weeks cadence, then handing the proven solution off to the Sr. Solutions Engineer for scale-up. The pattern is proven by AI-native companies - Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI - and this role brings that model to GSK. This senior engineer role embeds directly with business unit teams - product owners, engineering leads, and the wider BU - to understand the problem and execute. Most prototyping work is AI-augmented: AI coding assistants and multi-agent workflows handle the bulk of routine coding, freeing the FDE to focus on framing, judgement, and validation. The role works directly inside the customer s business and emerges with working software and a defensible value hypothesis - not slideware. The FDE does not carry use cases through to long-term operations - clean handoff to the Sr. Solutions Engineer is part of the role. Why This Role Exists: Enterprise AI s impact depends on engineers who can close the gap between what AI can do and what the business needs - fast, embedded, and without requiring the business to specify everything upfront. The FDE is that engineer. Proves AI ideas fast - shipping working prototypes at days-to-weeks cadence before significant investment is committed. Works directly inside the business - not at arm s length - building the trust and domain understanding that separate useful AI from academic AI. Builds the organisation s reusable AI engineering assets - every engagement distilled into patterns, agents, and reference architectures the whole team benefits from. Key Responsibilities PoC / PoV / MVP Delivery: Take ownership of high-priority BU use cases from problem framing through to a working prototype, at days-to-weeks cadence, and form a defensible view on whether each should progress. Ship first production versions directly for use cases where the path is clear - before the Sr. Solutions Engineer takes them forward to scale. AI-Native Engineering: Operate AI agent workflows (planning, coding, testing, review, documentation) for autonomous prototype delivery - selecting the right level of automation for each engagement. Use AI coding assistants as the default mode of building; provide judgement, course-correction, and validation. Customer Embedding Handoff: Embed with BU teams - attend standups, understand the domain, prototype against real data and real workflows. Package proven use cases cleanly for the Sr. Solutions Engineer - working code, architecture rationale, open risks, and scaling concerns. Governance, Standards Coaching: Begin Code Orange, Responsible AI, and Accountability Report conversations during prototyping - so the productionisation team does not inherit governance debt. Contribute reusable agents, prompt templates, and reference architectures to the organisation s pattern library after each engagement. Form and defend kill/continue recommendations at the end of each engagement - presenting clearly to BU and Enterprise AI leadership. Coach BU engineers on AI-augmented ways of working while embedded, building BU capability alongside delivery outcomes. Required Functional Experience Overall 15+years of full-stack or AI/ML engineering experience, including production deployments. Demonstrated ability to take ideas from sketch to working software at speed - startup, lab, or innovation-team background is ideal. Strong proficiency in Python and at least one of TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or similar. Hands-on experience with GenAI patterns: agents, multi-agent orchestration, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation. Daily use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Databricks AI Assistant) as the primary mode of development. Preferred Experience Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer at an AI-native company (Anthropic, Palantir, OpenAI, or similar), or as a Customer Engineer / Solutions Architect at a hyperscaler. Experience in regulated industries (pharma, healthcare, financial services) and familiarity with GxP, GDPR, and SOX. Working knowledge of fine-tuning fundamentals and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. Track record of contributing reusable engineering patterns back to a broader team. Education Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Master s degree/ Ph D in Mathematics, statistics, computer science or related field is advantageous. Skills Artificial Intelligence (AI) Artificial Intelligence Ethics Artificial Neural Networks (ANNS) Deep Learning Machine Learning (ML) Model Evaluation Model Validation Python (Programming Language) Test Documentation Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II
jobs.description: Job Summary At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors - Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together - help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Expedia Group powers global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting-edge technology to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential to driving our success. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. EG Clickstream provides data that captures user behavior and experience across Expedia Group sites and apps. This data forms the building blocks for understanding user journeys: what products users search for, which features they see and use, and which marketing channels they arrive from. It powers analysis of Product and Marketing performance to support optimized decision-making and can also be used programmatically to drive personalized, adaptive experiences for our users. As a Software Development Engineer II on Expedia Group's Clickstream team, you will design, build, and operate the real-time data platform that captures and processes user behavior across our sites and apps. You will engineer scalable, resilient streaming systems that power analytics, marketing, and personalized experiences globally. You bring strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, deep proficiency in coding and distributed systems design, and a passion for solving complex problems of scale. You are collaborative, creative, and thrive in a dynamic, agile environment where you continuously learn and raise the bar. What you will do Design, build, and operate highly available, low-latency streaming services and data pipelines (primarily in Java/Kotlin) running in public/hybrid cloud environments. Write clean, efficient, well-tested code; practice pair programming and conduct thorough code reviews. Apply object-oriented design, distributed computing, performance/scalability tuning, and advanced data structures/algorithms to real-time streaming and data processing. Build and evolve microservices and data APIs that power analytics and personalized experiences. Implement robust testing, monitoring, alerting, and observability to ensure reliability and rapid incident response. Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive long-term fixes and improvements. Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, analysts, and platform teams to deliver high-impact solutions. Contribute to technical design documents; communicate trade-offs and decisions clearly within the team. Stay current with advancements in cloud data platforms, streaming technologies, and best practices; mentor junior engineers. Requirements Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 2+ years of professional software development experience, including building and operating backend/microservices in Java; Kotlin or Scala experience is a plus. Hands-on experience with streaming platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub) and event-driven architectures. Experience building production-grade data processing applications in public/hybrid cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure). Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals: algorithms, data structures, concurrency, distributed systems, and design patterns. Proficiency in testing strategies (unit, integration), CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, and incident management. Familiarity with observability concepts and tools to monitor application health and performance. Strong debugging, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills; self-starter with a learning mindset. Familiarity with basic AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, code assistants) to accelerate development or documentation, used responsibly within company policies. Preferred qualifications Experience with Kafka Streams (KStream) and/or Apache Flink for stateful stream processing. jobs.description: Role & responsibilities Key Responsibilities Build our platform in Flutter across web and mobile, from first screen to release Turn complex real-estate workflows into screens that are fast and simple to use, on a desktop in a sales office or a phone at a site Write the backend your features need: Node.js and TypeScript services and the APIs behind them Model data in PostgreSQL that stays correct when many people work on the same records at once Keep every screen in step with live data, and keep the app usable on a weak connection: cached data, queued actions and a clear sign when something is still syncing Own quality end to end: performance, releases and tests Preferred candidate profile Must-Have Skills Flutter and Dart in production, including Flutter Web State management with Riverpod or BLoC Node.js and TypeScript: you have built APIs, not just called them PostgreSQL: schema design, transactions and indexing Real-time sync and offline-first patterns in Flutter: local cache, queued writes and resolving conflicts when they sync Profiling and fixing performance issues on web and mobile Good to Have Event-driven systems (message queues, event buses) Apps shipped to the Play Store or App Store B2B SaaS or real-estate products Tech Stack Flutter, Dart, Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL 1-3 Yrs Typescript, Full Stack, Dart, Node.js, Flutter, Flutter Development, Stack, Development
